headline: Nevish Line Eases; Godcrofts Quits Firing as Linn Mercy Holds
war_summary:
The Nevish Line's sudden eruption has cooled since the last edition. Six actions in two hours have become one in the last two, though twelve were still logged within six hours and Blackcoat Way and the Tomb Father works remain the scene of it. Godcrofts, busiest ground of the day with forty-six actions about Isawa, Fleecewatch and Ursa Base, has gone entirely silent over the past six hours, its nine works still Colonial. The Stlican Shelf reported a fresh action at Breaker Town late in the evening, its line standing eight Colonial to one Warden.

Linn Mercy holds nine Colonial works against a single Warden hold and one unclaimed, and its guns remain the heaviest in the south. Callahan's Passage again reports the sharpest hourly killing, near 797 Colonial and 540 Warden, while Weathered Expanse exacts the stiffer Warden price, 750 to 517, with two of its works still unclaimed. Palantine Berm and Marban Hollow stay split four Warden to three Colonial, both keeping up brisk exchange. The victory mark stands at thirty-four towns.
